evidence.reason: The fixture sets only user.email and user.name before committing. It never disables repository-local commit.gpgSign, so a developer with global commit.gpgSign=true will make Git attempt to sign as fixture@example.invalid; without a matching secret key the commit fails and DeployTests error in setUp(). Setting commit.gpgSign=false locally before the first commit is the minimal fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
